# al-Kindi: Digital Product Studio

> A digital product studio working from interfaces to smart contracts.

al-Kindi is a small, focused studio with roots in software and a strong foundation in design. The studio designs brands, ships products, and engineers onchain systems that feel natural to use and easy to understand. Some days we draw screens, some days we deploy contracts; most days, we do both.

Sound reasoning. Elegant engineering.

Legal entity: Alkindi, Unipessoal LDA. Based in Lisbon, Portugal.

## Selected Work

### Golem Foundation

A smart contract solution for the foundation behind the Golem protocol: designed, implemented, tested, and deployed by the studio. One accountable hand from specification to mainnet.

### Kleros

A smart contract solution for the decentralized dispute resolution protocol, designed, implemented, tested, and deployed, together with the fullstack application around it: from contract storage layout to the interface users touch.

## Services

Contracts that hold value can't be almost right. We build to that standard, onchain and off.

### 01. Smart Contract Development

EVM contracts shipped audit-ready: spec, source, invariant tests, fuzz suite, deploy scripts. The studio writes invariants before the contracts and covers every state path before deploy.

### 02. Smart Contract Audits

EVM contract audits that end in remediation, not just findings. Manual review, fuzzing, invariant testing, and economic analysis: each finding root-caused, each fix reviewed.

### 03. Technical Advisory

Architecture reviews, tech decisions, Web3 integration, security posture. Written assessments with a recommendation, including 'don't' when that is the answer.

### 04. Brand & Visual Identity

Brand systems made to be used, not just admired. The studio designs naming, marks, type systems, color, and voice as one piece, built to last.

### 05. Copywriting

Plain words for complex products. From brand voice to landing pages, UI microcopy to long-form content, the studio writes copy that lands on first read.

### 06. Web Design

The studio handles every layer of a web project: strategy (sitemap, information architecture, content hierarchy), design (layout, type, motion), build (semantic markup, performance, accessibility), and ship (deployment, maintenance).

### 07. Graphics & Digital Art

Original illustration, motion, and motifs. The studio draws by hand or writes the generative code; nothing is pulled from a stock library.

### 08. User Experience Design

Research (interviews, observation), synthesis (journey maps, problem statements), structure (information architecture, user flows), validation (prototypes, usability testing). The studio frames the right problem before solving it.

### 09. User Interface Design

Interfaces that do not need a guide, a tutorial, or a tooltip. Components, tokens, states, and prototypes drawn and shipped intact.

### 10. Web App Development

Web apps shipped with everything a new team needs to take over: code, docs, tests, deploy pipeline. The studio builds with the smallest codebase that does the job.

### 11. Hi-Fi Listening Rooms

Room layout, gear sourcing and purchasing, system assembly, acoustic measurement, and tuning. The studio builds one listening room at a time, measured to actually sound right, not just to look good.

## About al-Kindi

A small, focused studio with roots in software and a strong foundation in design.

The studio prefers clear scope, honest dialogue, and work that can stand on its own without big words. Sometimes that means adding a feature; sometimes it means simplifying and removing noise.

The studio is not chasing trends. The aim is to help clients build something useful, consistent, and well-made.

## Origin of the name

al-Kindi, Abu Yusuf Yaʻqub ibn Ishaq al-Kindi, was a 9th-century Baghdadi polymath who wrote on philosophy, music, optics, and invented cryptanalysis. The frequency analysis he laid out in Baghdad broke every cipher humanity had built; no system resistant to it would emerge for seven centuries. The same hand tuned an oud, translated Aristotle, and read enciphered letters.

The same "al-" is everywhere in Portugal, where the studio works: Alfama, Algarve, Alentejo, Almada; quiet traces of the Arabic-speaking world he came from.

Eleven centuries later, his work on ciphers is the foundation of every smart contract the studio deploys. The studio borrowed the name in tribute.

## Team

Two cities. One studio.

### Münevver Aslan, Digital Product Designer

Istanbul · Lisbon. Münevver brings a multidisciplinary eye to every project, spanning brand systems, interaction design, and the fine line between clarity and character. Born in Istanbul, now based between Lisbon and wherever the work takes her.

### Ferit Tunçer, Founder & Smart Contract Engineer

Lisbon. The engineering half of al-Kindi and founder of the studio. Ten years building production software with deep focus on Ethereum: smart contract development, security review, and gas-sensitive protocol work. Cypherpunk by orientation, computer science by training. Based in Lisbon.
